channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Family remembers father of 2 killed in an industrial accident in Tarpon Springs
item.description: On Aug. 10, deputies responded to 800 Anclote Road around 7:43 a.m. regarding a possible explosion. 36-year-old Justin Wilt was airlifted to a hospital and died days later. The investigation is ongoing.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] US and Canadian tariffs are set to target everyday goods, and your wallet
item.description: The political fight between the U.S. and Canada is now impacting your money, as the U.S. slaps 50% tariffs on a long list of Canadian goods.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Sen. Darline Graham wins GOP primary runoff to replace her late brother in US Senate
item.description: U.S. Sen. Darline Graham won the Republican nomination to replace her late brother Lindsey Graham on South Carolina’s general election ballot.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Dolly Parton’s legacy lives on across Tampa Bay through music, art and literacy
item.description: Dolly Parton’s death marks the end of a remarkable career, but people across the Tampa Bay area are remembering the country music legend for much more than her music.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Dolly Parton mural Tampa: Artist finishes tribute weeks before icon's death
item.description: Tributes to Dolly Parton are pouring in from around the country, including one painted on the side of a Tampa Heights business.
